# Incident report: checkout failures (2026-11-05)

## Summary
Between 14:03 and 14:29 UTC, checkout-web returned 5xx errors for about 17.6% of requests (SEV1 threshold is >10%). payments-api p99 latency rose to about 3.15 s. The cause was the feature flag `tax_engine_v2` ramping from 10% to 100% at 14:02 (change `flg_2210`). Reverting the flag to 10% restored service. Checkout error rate is 0.4% and payments-api p99 is 450 ms as of 14:31 UTC.

## Timeline (UTC)
- 13:41 `dep_7781`: payments-api v2.13.4 -> v2.14.0 (no errors that followed; ruled out)
- 14:02 `flg_2210`: tax_engine_v2 rollout 10% -> 100% (release-train)
- 14:02:31 payments-api: TaxEngineV2 timeouts (3000 ms) calling tax-service /v2/quote
- 14:03 checkout-web error rate jumps to 17.6%; payments-api p99 alert fires (alt_31)
- 14:03:01 tax-service: /v2/quote p99 3021 ms, shedding load
- 14:06 checkout-web 5xx alert fires (alt_32)
- 14:08:45 tax-service: /v2/quote worker pool exhausted
- 14:21 incident commander begins response
- 14:27 tax_engine_v2 set to 10% (previous rollout); effective within about 2 minutes
- 14:29 checkout-web error rate falls to 0.4%; payments-api p99 falls to 450 ms
- 14:32 alerts: only alt_33 (search-api warning) remains

## Root cause
Flag `tax_engine_v2` (`flg_2210`) moved to 100% at 14:02. Every checkout then called tax-service `/v2/quote`, which could not handle the full load. Its worker pool was exhausted and calls timed out. payments-api returned 502 on /charge, and checkout-web reported payment failures. The timing (one minute before onset), the log messages, and the affected service all match.

## Other changes checked
- `cfg_0412` (tax-service DB pool 50 -> 80, 13:15, jsato): 48 minutes before onset with no errors in between. Not the trigger, but the tax-platform team should review it alongside capacity.
- `dep_7790` (search-api v5.2.0 -> v5.2.1, 14:05): search-api p99 moved from about 310 ms to 430 ms, then 330 ms. It did not affect checkout and is still a warning (alt_33). Not rolled back, since no link to checkout errors was found.

## Mitigation
Set `tax_engine_v2` rollout from 100% to 10% (the previous rollout). Chosen as the least risky step under the runbook. No deploy rollback was needed.

## Verification
- checkout-web error rate: 17.6% (14:21) -> 0.4% (14:30)
- payments-api p99: 3150 ms -> 450 ms (14:31)
- Active alerts: alt_31 and alt_32 cleared. alt_33 (search-api p95 warning) remains and is not checkout-related.

Verified recovery: yes. Still at 10% rollout. Full rollout of tax_engine_v2 must wait until tax-service /v2/quote has capacity for full traffic.

## Communications
- Status page: SEV1 "identified" at 14:28, "mitigated" at about 14:32.
- Paged `payments` (high): acknowledged.
- Paged `tax-platform` (high): acknowledged. Note: "tax-service" is not a valid team name; the owning team is `tax-platform`.

## Follow-ups
1. tax-platform: fix /v2/quote capacity (worker pool, load shedding) before re-enabling the flag above 10%.
2. release-train: ramp flags gradually, with a guard on downstream capacity. A 10% -> 100% jump in one step caused this.
3. payments: confirm the TaxEngineV2 timeout and fallback behaviour so that a tax-service failure does not fail checkout.
4. discovery: review search-api p95 warning (alt_33) from dep_7790.
5. Review cfg_0412 with tax-platform.
